title: 1st Step | Online Yakshagana Class | Class 1 | Sushma Mayya

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains basic Yakshagana postures and steps clearly with structured verbal instructions. She demonstrates movements from the front angle while breaking down exercises into numbered counts.

lesson_structure.note: Prayer and paying respect to deities and mother earth
Comparing posture with Bharatanatyam to avoid mistakes
Dividing the first step into four speeds
Practicing the first speed with counts
Summary of today's class and application of the step

common_mistakes: bending knees too much like Bharatanatyam
tilting head down and losing focus
letting feet go too far apart causing loss of balance
safety: keep head straight and level to avoid neck strain and crown imbalance

steps_taught.name: Yaksha Stithi
steps_taught.description: Basic Yakshagana stance with heels joined and toes opened

steps_taught.name: First Hejje (Speed 1)
steps_taught.description: Very slow first step with thatto dimmi counts

what_works: breaking down the step into four distinct speed levels from slow to fast
what_hinders: long verbal explanations before physical demonstration
